from math import gcd


def best_average(a: list[int], k: int) -> list[int]:
    n = len(a)
    prefix = [0] * (n + 1)
    for i, x in enumerate(a):
        prefix[i + 1] = prefix[i] + x

    # Dinkelbach iteration with exact integer arithmetic.
    # Current guess lam = p / q, starting from the first window of length k.
    p, q = prefix[k], k
    while True:
        best = None
        best_i = best_j = 0
        min_f = None
        min_i = 0
        for j in range(k, n + 1):
            i = j - k
            # f(i) = q*S[i] - p*i; maximize q*(S[j]-S[i]) - p*(j-i) over valid i
            f = q * prefix[i] - p * i
            if min_f is None or f < min_f:
                min_f = f
                min_i = i
            val = q * prefix[j] - p * j - min_f
            if best is None or val > best:
                best = val
                best_i = min_i
                best_j = j
        if best <= 0:
            break
        p, q = prefix[best_j] - prefix[best_i], best_j - best_i

    g = gcd(p, q)
    return [p // g, q // g]
